explanation:
I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem says that if the stabilizer of v is open, then so is the stabilizer of g • v (under the hypothesis ContinuousMul G). What I searched:
- Statements that mention both `IsOpen` and `stabilizer`. The only hits were `stabilizer_isOpen`, which needs a discrete topology on the target, `continuousSMul_iff_stabilizer_isOpen`, and `stabilizer_isOpen_of_isIntegral`, which is about Galois groups. None of them covers this case.
- Conjugation lemmas in Topology/Algebra, such as `IsTopologicalGroup.continuous_conj`.
- `stabilizer_smul*` lemmas.

The closest result is `MulAction.stabilizer_smul_eq_stabilizer_map_conj`, which says the stabilizer of g • a is the conjugate of the stabilizer of a. Getting the theorem from it would also need a separate argument that conjugation keeps a set open, so it combines two results. That is beyond a one- or two-line special case.
